scenario: `*` wildcard in selective-import lists is not supported per LIMP.2.4.2. Pin: `from ha import *` rejects at parse — the grammar's `import_name` production accepts only `IDENT | TYPE_NAME`, so `*` surfaces as an unexpected token after `import`. The selective-import list must enumerate each imported name; v1 commits to the smallest viable surface.
